description: RFC 1071 internet checksum. Big-endian 16-bit words are added with end-around carry, then inverted. An odd final byte is padded with zero. The RFC example 0001 F203 F4F5 F6F7 is 220d. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/inet-checksum
name: inet_checksum
title: Inet Checksum
